items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: Royal, he was a Sam Morgan drum player... he played with a Sam Morgan band all the time... I wasn't playing no drums then.

ctx.x: See, Fess is six years older than you. Oh. But his uncle was a good deal older than that. Yeah. I wondered if there was much difference between the music over there. I guess all the same fellas played on each side though.
Oh, Sam. Well, the music then was good. But as it kept coming, coming, coming, the fellas got better and better.
